title: No automatic provider MCP config rewrites
content: In blackbox, daemon startup must not rewrite provider-owned MCP configuration files. Persistent provider MCP registration may change Claude/Codex/Copilot/Gemini/Vibe configs only as the direct result of an explicit user/tool action such as `bro_mcp add`, `bro_mcp remove`, or `bro_mcp sync`; dispatch-time injection may use transient args/env without mutating those configs.
